newsitem.title: USA: Bristol-Myers, Affymetrix, Millennium in gene pact.
newsitem.headline: Bristol-Myers, Affymetrix, Millennium in gene pact.

text.p: Bristol-Myers Squibb Co said Tuesday that it, Affymetrix Inc and Millennium Pharmaceuticals Inc have formed a consortium to fund a five-year research program in functional genomics at the Whitehead Institute/MIT Center for Genome Research.
Bristol said that the new program will advance the development of gene-based technologies for research and health care.

Under the terms of the agreement, the three companies will support a program of investigator-initiated research at the Whitehead/MIT Center for Genome Center by providing funds totaling about $8 million per year for five years, and providing Whitehead's Genome Center with access to Affymetrix and Millennium technologies.
Scientists at the companies will also collaborate with scientists at the Genome Center in the development and application of new genomic tools.
In return, the companies will receive certain licensing rights to all developments funded by the consortium or emerging from the use of contributed technology.
Separately, Bristol-Myers also said that it has expanded its internal genomics capabilites through the creation of a Department of Applied Genetics.

The Department is expected to engage initially over 60 dedicated researchers in the areas of DNA sequencing, molecular biology, informatics, functional genomics/high throughput biology, robotics, and statistical genetics, in addition to the many molecular biologists assigned to therapeutic areas within Drug Discovery.
